q: 最近一年奶牛产奶量按月怎么变化的?
帮我统计一下今年一共挤了多少奶
sql: SELECT SUM(milk_yield) AS 今年总产奶量_千克 FROM dwh_fact_milk WHERE YEAR(record_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) LIMIT 100

q: 哪五个牧场的奶量最多?给我排个序
detail: 前 5 名次序与真值一致
sql: SELECT f.farm_name AS 牧场, SUM(m.milk_yield) AS 总产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id GROUP BY f.farm_name ORDER BY 总产奶量 DESC LIMIT 5

q: 上个月各个品种分别产了多少奶?
sql: SELECT c.breed AS 品种, SUM(m.milk_yield) AS 产奶量_千克 FROM dwh_fact_milk m JOIN dwh_dim_cattle c ON m.cattle_id = c.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-07-01' AND m.record_date < '2026-08-01' GROUP BY c.breed ORDER BY 产奶量_千克 DESC LIMIT 100

q: 给我看看上个月牧场之间的乳脂率差距
sql: SELECT f.farm_name AS 牧场, ROUND(AVG(m.fat_rate), 3) AS 平均乳脂率, COUNT(*) AS 记录数 FROM dwh_fact_milk m JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-07-01' AND m.record_date < '2026-08-01' GROUP BY f.farm_name ORDER BY 平均乳脂率 DESC LIMIT 20

q: 最近半年每天产奶量走势怎么样?
sql: SELECT record_date AS 记录日期, SUM(milk_yield) AS 产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk WHERE record_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY record_date ORDER BY record_date LIMIT 200

q: 荷斯坦牛占了泌乳牛的多大比例?
note: 真值=70.08%,接受百分数或小数两种口径
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.breed = '荷斯坦' THEN m.cattle_id END) AS 荷斯坦泌乳牛数, COUNT(DISTINCT m.cattle_id) AS 泌乳牛总数, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.breed = '荷斯坦' THEN m.cattle_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.cattle_id), 2) AS 荷斯坦占比百分比 FROM dwh_fact_milk m JOIN dwh_dim_cattle c ON m.cattle_id = c.id LIMIT 10

q: 哪个牧场6月比5月产奶量下降最多?
detail: 命中标签 呼和浩特金山牧场
sql: SELECT f.farm_name AS 牧场, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(m.record_date)=5 THEN m.milk_yield ELSE 0 END) AS 五月产奶量, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(m.record_date)=6 THEN m.milk_yield ELSE 0 END) AS 六月产奶量, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(m.record_date)=6 THEN m.milk_yield ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(m.record_date)=5 THEN m.milk_yield ELSE 0 END) AS 变化量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE MONTH(m.record_date) IN (5,6) GROUP BY f.farm_name ORDER BY 变化量 ASC LIMIT 10

q: 有没有牧场最近两个月产奶量连续下滑?
detail: 全部 2 个标签均出现
sql: SELECT 牧场, 月份, 产奶量, 上月产奶量, 上上月产奶量 FROM (SELECT 牧场, 月份, 产奶量, LAG(产奶量,1) OVER (PARTITION BY 牧场 ORDER BY 月份) AS 上月产奶量, LAG(产奶量,2) OVER (PARTITION BY 牧场 ORDER BY 月份) AS 上上月产奶量 FROM (SELECT f.farm_name AS 牧场, DATE_FORMAT(m.record_date, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, SUM(m.milk_yield) AS 产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-05-01' GROUP BY f.farm_name, DATE_FORMAT(m.record_date, '%Y-%m')) t) u WHERE 产奶量 < 上月产奶量 AND 上月产奶量 < 上上月产奶量 ORDER BY 牧场, 月份 LIMIT 100
